reviews.title: Why is this app so terrible!!!!
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for the past few years now because when I purchased the security camera I was told this is the app that is used. Given the price I paid I was expecting it to be good. I’ve always had issues that don’t ever seem to get fixed! It takes so long to load live stream in the moment, that by the time it does load, I’ve missed who is on my property! It fails to record most motion detection. I can hear audio sound whilst on live stream, but on any recordings on playback, there is no sound/audio recorded. 
I used to get alerts come through at first, but they’ve not worked for ages now, even though my setting are set to receive notifications. To top it off, this past week it’s not recording anything at all!!! Nothing on playback and ALL of my previous recordings have gone!!! There’s no support network I can contact to fix these issues. I just hope nothing serious happens on my property as I may as well not have a camera at all considering how awful this app is!! Please get these issues fixed ASAP, or at least provide a phone number for app support.

reviews.title: طلب دعم فني بخصوص عرض التسجيلات في تطبيق DMSS
reviews.text:
السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته،
تحية طيبة لفريق تطوير تطبيق DMSS،

أنا مستخدم للتطبيق منذ فترة، وقد لاحظت مؤخرًا مشكلة تتعلق بعرض التسجيلات في قسم التخزين. عند مراجعة الفيديوهات، لا يظهر لي التسجيل حتى اللحظة الأخيرة كما كان في السابق، بل يتوقف العرض عند وقت متأخر (مثل الساعة 6:40 مساءً) رغم أن الوقت الفعلي يكون مثلًا 7:40 مساءً.

أرجو منكم التكرم بمراجعة هذا الخلل، سواء كان متعلقًا بطريقة التسجيل أو إعدادات المزامنة أو أي تحديثات طرأت على التطبيق مؤخرًا، وإرشادي إلى الخطوات التي يمكنني اتخاذها لضمان عرض التسجيلات بشكل كامل حتى آخر لحظة.

شاكر لكم جهودكم، وفي انتظار ردكم الكريم.

مع خالص التحية،
أبو طلال
النعيم – محافظة الجهراء – الكويت

---


Dear DMSS Development Team,

I have been using the DMSS app for some time, and I recently noticed an issue with video playback in the storage section. When reviewing the footage, the recordings do not display up to the current moment as they used to. Instead, playback stops at an earlier time (e.g., 6:40 PM), even though the actual time is 7:40 PM.

I kindly request that you investigate this issue, whether it is related to recording settings, synchronization, or recent updates to the app, and guide me on the steps I can take to ensure that recordings are displayed completely up to the latest moment.

Thank you for your efforts, and I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Abu Talal
Al-Naeem – Al-Jahra Governorate – Kuwait
